# anthropic_federation_issuer (Resource)

Manages a Workload Identity Federation issuer (`fdis_…`) — an OIDC identity provider whose JWTs may assert workload identity for your organization.

Requires the provider's `oauth_token` (an `org:admin` OAuth bearer token).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register GitHub Actions as an OIDC issuer (JWKS discovery).
resource "anthropic_federation_issuer" "github_actions" {
  name       = "github-actions"
  issuer_url = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"

  jwks = {
    type = "discovery"
  }
}

# Explicit JWKS URL example:
# jwks = {
#   type = "explicit_url"
#   url  = "https://example.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
# }
#
# Inline keys (air-gapped issuers):
# jwks = {
#   type      = "inline"
#   keys_json = jsonencode([{ kty = "RSA", n = "...", e = "AQAB" }])
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_url` (String) The exact `iss` claim value in the provider's JWTs, e.g. `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`.
- `jwks` (Attributes) How Anthropic fetches the provider's JWT signing keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jwks))
- `name` (String) Name of the issuer. Must match `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, 1–255 chars, unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the issuer was archived, or null if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the issuer was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the federation issuer (`fdis_…`).

<a id="nestedatt--jwks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jwks`

Required:

- `type` (String) One of `discovery` (fetch `/.well-known/openid-configuration` at the issuer URL), `explicit_url` (use `url`), or `inline` (use `keys_json`).

Optional:

- `keys_json` (String) A JSON array of JWK objects. Required when `type = inline` (for issuers not reachable from the public internet).
- `url` (String) JWKS endpoint URL. Required when `type = explicit_url`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing federation issuer by its ID
terraform import anthropic_federation_issuer.github_actions fdis_xxxxx
```
